summary.text: Luke Muszkiewicz is a Democratic member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 79 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A software engineer and data analyst, he served on the Helena Public Schools Board of Trustees from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Muszkiewicz was born in Helena, Montana, and earned a high school diploma from Helena High School in 1996 and a bachelor's degree from Carroll College in 2000.
His career experience includes working as a software engineer and data analyst in the public accounting industry.
He served on the Helena Public Schools Board of Trustees from 2017 to 2023.
Muszkiewicz took office on January 6, 2025, and was assigned to the House Ethics and Appropriations committees for 2025-2026.
